artMethod: Each of three layer lifetimes adds 4 warmup and 12 full real WebGL draws (sim ticks 20-31), 36 samples total; too few to infer stable p99; 1000-unit real simulation replay, all selected, deterministic 50ms tick timestamps, 1280x720 DPR1; gl.finish fences software GPU completion. FullDrawFenced includes CPU scene updates, WebGL submission and SwiftShader completion. CpuSubmission excludes finish. No simulation runs in this fixture; do not report these as hardware FPS.
method: Three dynamic cycles; ten real-WebGL hover-only cases per cycle for own/ally/enemy ground troops, deck crew and hulls plus sloped bridge crew, with per-instance position/color/height/stroke checks; real full-selection draws before/after CPU samples. 120 fixed-snapshot full-selection and 120 fresh-tick alternating-selection CPU draws per cycle; renderer.render disabled only during CPU timing, excluding GPU work. All disposed layer references retained intentionally to verify explicit release; GC requested through CDP. Teardown follows main.ts layer, request/decode, portrait and shared-model ordering. CPU samples are not device FPS.

replay.method: 1000 real units, every land kind, two armies of 500 attack-moving with 75% initial HP. Healing autocast is disabled with real player commands initially and re-enabled before tick 20 to exercise actual cast events during sampling. Sixty real simulation ticks precomputed once; identical replay reused by each render cycle. Rendering cost excludes this precomputation; no AI planner. Each replay frame advances real animation/motion/facing trackers.
